scientific_role: Construct the already-defined I1 provider card from frozen provider-local evidence using the recovered coordinate-wise 0.95-at-120 trace calibration, without A_G localization or method-driven construction choices.

retained_valid_evidence.persistent_evidence: provider-local request ledgers for ProviderA, ProviderB and ProviderC

frozen_I1_schema.definition: I1_i=(A_i,W_i,R,{sigma_i(A_i,H;rho): H in H, rho in R})

rho_handling.scientific_note: The frozen anchor global query rho_G=0.95 is used inside the predeclared T_i-to-A_i coordinate calibration. This is not a provider-specific rho_i. After A_i is fixed, Phase 2 materializes the complete frozen R support.

direct_pipeline: for each provider and each coordinate separately, calibrate the threshold whose first sigma_i(A_i^X,H;rho_G=0.95) crossing below 0.95 is closest to H*=120 s
combine the three coordinate thresholds into one rectangular A_i without forcing the joint sigma at H*=120 to 0.95
compute sigma_i(A_i,H;rho) for every rho in the frozen R support
supply the identical finished I1_i to M0 and M1

A_i_instantiation.candidate_family: observed provider-local coordinate thresholds, ordered from strict to relaxed
A_i_instantiation.selection_rule: for L, C and Q separately choose the threshold whose first sigma_i(A_i^X,H;rho_anchor) crossing below sigma_target occurs closest to H_star
A_i_instantiation.combine_rule: A_i={L_i<=l_i_star,C_i<=c_i_star,Q_i>=q_i_star}; joint sigma at H_star is diagnostic, not a calibration target
A_i_instantiation.constant_quality_rule: if Q has one unique finite value, use that value directly

materialization.input: only the frozen private T_i corpora plus frozen Phase-2 contracts

m0_boundary.M0_interpretation: analytic baseline prediction, not a global-rho certification lower bound
